title: Adaptive Request Deep-Dive Workspace (multi-span comparison + cost overlay)
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design an Adaptive Request Deep-Dive workspace for the Redwood Console that lets engineers and SREs inspect one or more requests side-by-side. The workspace combines an interactive span timeline, correlation ID mapping, fuzzy match search for partial IDs, lightweight span sparklines, and a cost-per-request overlay derived from token and inference-attribution metadata. The goal is a single UI for fast root-cause workflows, cost correlation, and multi-request comparison without leaving the Console.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Users can load a primary request by correlation ID and add up to 3 comparison anchors (requests) to the workspace.
2) Timeline view supports zoom and pan, and shows aligned span lanes across compared requests with hover-to-highlight matching spans.
3) Correlation ID matching supports exact and fuzzy modes (prefix, suffix, regex) with clear UI toggle.
4) Cost overlay displays token-count and estimated GPU-cost per request and highlights spans contributing to >75% of cost.
5) Query builder allows filtering by service, operation name, status, and duration; results update the comparison lanes in <500ms for typical workspace size.
6) Prototypes exist in Figma with both desktop and tablet variants and include accessible color contrast and keyboard navigation patterns.
7) Handoff notes for ENG include data contract for cost attribution fields and an instrumentation checklist.
8) Usability check with 3 engineers yields task completion for 'find longest tail span across 3 similar requests' in under 2 minutes.
design_notes: High-level idea: an adaptable canvas where the left rail contains request metadata (correlation IDs, time, route, token counts, model version), the center is a shared time axis with synchronized zoom, and the right rail surfaces span detail and cost breakdown for the active span. Use color-coded service lanes; where spans align across anchors draw faint vertical connectors. Provide an 'explode' action to open a focused span waterfall for a single request.
accessibility_considerations: Use color palettes that meet 4.5:1 contrast for important status and cost indicators. Ensure keyboard-only timeline navigation (arrow keys to pan, +/- to zoom) and ARIA labels for span rows. Provide an alternative text summary for exportable snapshots.
engineering_notes: Will need backend endpoints: /trace/compare?ids=.. returning aligned-span-index and cost-attribution per-span. Also a fuzzy-match endpoint for correlation IDs. Expect changes to trace ingestion to attach token_count and model_variant metadata. Performance target: 95th percentile render within 600ms for three request anchors. Coordinate with ENG-5104 (aligned-span-index API) and ENG-5120 (cost attribution schema).
